title: Rory and the Gentle Moonlit Grove
verses:
The sun tumbled down past the sleepy green trees,
And stars started shining above,
As Rory walked slowly along through the ferns,
Wrapped up in a blanket of love.

Now Tilly was waiting beside a calm pool,
Where Benny was taking a rest,
They smiled as the night wind blew softly and cool,
To gather the ones they loved best.

High up in the branches flew Nia so slow,
While Ricky tiptoed on the ground,
They looked for a corner where sweet blossoms grow,
Without making any big sound.

Then Psittaco chirped from a nest made of moss,
And settled right under a leaf,
The shadows stretched out as they floated across,
To bring them a cozy relief.

And Benny curled down near the edge of the stream,
As Rory snuggled close to his side,
The valley was wrapped in a shadowy dream,
Where all of the sleepy stars hide.

The fireflies flickered to wish them goodnight,
As darkness fell over the hill,
And Rory fell fast into dreams sweet and light,
While all of the jungle grew still.
